Food: Create a Food token, which can be sacrificed for life gain.
Discover: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value equal to or less than a specified number. You may cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand.
Abandon: In Unstable, remove a Contraption from the battlefield.
Explore: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land, put it into your hand. If not, put a +1/+1 counter on the creature, then choose to keep the card on top or put it into your graveyard.
Treasure: Create a Treasure token, which can be sacrificed for one mana of any color.
Roll to Visit Your Attractions: In Unfinity, roll a die to determine which Attractions are visited.
Set in motion: In Archenemy, begin the effect of a Scheme card.
Fateseal: Look at the top cards of an opponent's library and put any number on the bottom of that library and the rest on top in any order.
Manifest: Put a card from your library onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature.
Populate: Create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control.
Detain: Until your next turn, target creature can't attack, block, or activate abilities.
Investigate: Create a Clue token, which can be sacrificed to draw a card.
Monstrosity: If the creature isn't monstrous, put a specified number of +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.
Clash: Each player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on top or bottom. The player with the higher mana cost wins the clash.
Scry: Look at a specified number of cards from the top of your library, then put any number on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.
Incubate: Create an Incubator token with a specified number of +1/+1 counters. You can transform it into a creature later.
Proliferate: Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.
Meld: Combine two specific cards into one oversized card with combined abilities.
Convert: Transform a double-faced card to its other face.
Fight: Two creatures deal damage equal to their power to each other.
Bolster: Choose a creature with the least toughness among creatures you control and put a specified number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Assemble: In Unstable, create a Contraption and assign it to a sprocket.
Conjure: Create a copy of a card and put it into your hand or onto the battlefield.
Amass: Create a 0/0 black Zombie Army token, then put a specified number of +1/+1 counters on it. If you already control one, just add the counters.
Cloak: Put a card onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with ward 2. It can be turned face up by paying its mana cost.
Suspect: In Murders at Karlov Manor, mark a creature as a suspect, affecting how it can be interacted with.
Collect evidence: Exile cards from your graveyard with total mana value equal to or greater than a specified number to activate an effect.
Role token: Assign a Role token to a creature, granting it additional abilities or effects.
Plot: Exile a card from your hand with plot. You may cast it on a later turn without paying its mana cost.
Heist: In Murders at Karlov Manor, a mechanic involving stealing or exiling cards for value.
Forage: In Bloomburrow, a mechanic involving searching your library for specific cards.
Manifest dread: A variant of manifest, possibly from a specific set, involving face-down creatures with additional effects.
Endure: A mechanic representing a creature's ability to survive damage or effects.
Behold: Look at a specified number of cards from the top of your library, then put them back in any order or into your hand.
